name: Six Days Christian Tour Of Egypt From Cairo
description: Declare your inner feeling during your Egypt Holy Land Tours to famous Coptic area in Egypt such as hanging Church in Cairo, Al-Baramus Monastery in wadi El Natrun and amazing tour to Sant Catherine from Cairo to visit the Sant Catherine Monastery and Moses Mountain.
overview: Declare your inner feeling during your Egypt Holy Land Tours to famous Coptic area in Egypt such as hanging Church in Cairo, Al-Baramus Monastery in wadi El Natrun and amazing tour to Sant Catherine from Cairo to visit the Sant Catherine Monastery and Moses Mountain.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Pyramids – Museum – Coptic Cairo Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and The Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at an oriental restaurant in Cairo , continue your visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Wadi El Natrun Monasteries Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo, he will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to Wadi El-Natroun, Wadi El-Natroun well known as the monasticism area for Christians, embrace the Christian culture by visiting Al-Baramus Monastery, it is the one of the oldest monasteries in the area, then move towards Anba Makar Monastery, it is well known as Anba Makaryus Monastery, proceed to Anba Bishoi Monastery, The cemetery of Anba Bishoi is inside the Anba Bishoi Monastery, your last stop will be to El-Suryan Monastery, at the end of your day tour Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Saint Catherine Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo, he will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to unforgettable trip to Saint Catherine, passing by Moses Eyes, continue driving till arrive to the seven daughters Monastery, have a short visit to the seven Daughters Monastery, continue driving till arrive to St. Catherine, check in, manage to relax at hotel, enjoy the relish of your dinner at hotel. Overnight in St. Catherine

itinerary.title: Moses Mountains, Saint Catherine Monastery
itinerary.description: Wake up call at 01:30 am., A cup of tea will be offered to each person for free, around 02:00 am, it is your chance to escape the crowds, try different adventure while climbing Moses mountain, enjoy the sun rising over Sinai Mountains, then come down for a magical visit to Saint Catherine Monastery, passing by Room of the Skulls, the last point will be to the famous burning bush, at the end of your tour drive back to Cairo Note: you can travel to Israel or Jordan from St, Catherine via Taba border with against back to Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Day 6: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet & assist at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned modern Van.
Accommodation for 04 Nights in Cairo on Bed & Breakfast
Accommodation for 01Night in Saint Catherine in four Star Hotel including breakfast and dinner
01 Day Excursion in Cairo as mentioned at the above itinerary
01 Day Excursion in Wadi El Natrun Monasteries as mentioned at the above itinerary
01 Lunch at good quality restaurant in Cairo
A Bottle of Mineral Water to each person
English speaking guide in Cairo, Wadi El Natrun and St, Catherine during your tours
All Entrance fees to the above mentioned Excursions as mentioned at the itinerary
Long Transfers from Cairo/ Saint Catherine/ Cairo
Transfer to Cairo International airport for your final departure.
exclusions: Supplement cost for the Grand Egyptian Museum instead of the Old Egyptian Museum: USD 25 per person
